lines: "Woman came through the market with no augments. None. Not even a jaw plate."
"Wildblood. They put nothing in and they take nothing out. Say the body's the last thing left that nobody can patch from a distance."
"That's poverty with a flag on it."
"Tell her so. She'll agree with you and still be right."
"Ascendants call them animals. An animal outlasts a bad implant in this rain, so."
